question: Is it acceptable for Gateway and cron catalog reads to fail closed when two configured agents resolve to the same agent directory, or must that existing shape retain a deterministic supported owner?
rationale: The patch intentionally turns an ambiguous owner into an error to prevent cross-agent catalog mixing, but repository policy treats fail-closed and configuration compatibility changes as upgrade-sensitive when an existing setup could stop at runtime.

options.title: Confirm directory uniqueness
options.body: Document and retain the fail-closed invariant if each configured agent must already own a unique agent directory.

options.title: Preserve a supported shared-directory mode
options.body: Define and test a deterministic explicit-owner rule if multiple configured agents may legitimately share an agent directory.

recommendation.title: Confirm directory uniqueness
recommendation.body: Document and retain the fail-closed invariant if each configured agent must already own a unique agent directory.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the merged catalog-owner invariant and this centralizing follow-up.
